children: Pixelworks' revenue rose 57% year over year, while its net loss narrowed as revenue was primarily related to license revenue; discontinued operations reported no income or loss compared with a year-earlier loss.
¹ Reported as “Revenue, net”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to Pixelworks, Inc.”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Third-quarter 2026 revenue was primarily related to license revenue; 2025 revenue was primarily services.
: Gross profit was 92% of revenue, compared with 90% a year earlier.
: The first-quarter plan reduced the continuing-operations workforce by approximately 43%; no restructuring expense was recorded in the quarter.
: After selling PWSH in January, Pixelworks is focused on cinematic visualization solutions, including its TrueCut Motion platform.
